From a single-room consulting firm in Bengaluru to a manufacturing company serving clients across India and internationally — this is the Jayveecons story.

Currently viewing 1987 — The Founding
1987–1995 · Bengaluru, Karnataka
The Founding

Built from
the Ground Up

In 1987, K.R. Subramanian founded Jayveecons as a consulting firm in Bengaluru — with a singular focus on helping small-scale cement plants master Vertical Shaft Kiln technology. What started as engineering consultancy quickly became something larger: a full-scale design and manufacturing company serving the bulk processing needs of Indian industry.

The quality of early solutions — and the trust built with those first clients — opened doors across mining, food processing, steel, and waste management. Demand grew faster than consulting could serve. That demand became the catalyst to build.

Jayveecons made the transition from consultancy to manufacturer — investing in equipment, floor space, and people. Today, the company operates a 90,000 sq.ft machining and fabrication facility, designing and building the full spectrum of material handling and processing equipment under one roof.

"Moving your world ahead drives our belief that customer satisfaction comes in providing cost-effective and superior products and services coupled with technological innovation."

— Jayveecons Company Mission

Three decades of customer feedback is built into every machine we design. Every iteration reflects real operational experience — resulting in equipment that runs harder, requires less maintenance, and outlasts the industry standard. That feedback loop is the engine that has kept us growing since 1987.

01
Concept & Engineering Design
Every project starts with your process requirements. Our engineers design to your capacity, material, and site parameters — not to a generic catalogue spec.
02
In-House Fabrication
90,000 sq.ft of machining and fabrication capability. We manufacture to our own drawings, under our own quality control. Nothing critical is subcontracted.
03
Erection & Commissioning
Our teams install and commission at your site — ensuring the equipment that leaves our floor arrives performing to specification in the field.
04
Parts, Spares & After-Sales
Because we manufacture the equipment, we stock the parts. Long-term support backed by the same team that built your machine.

Company History

The Journey

1987
Founding
Jayveecons Founded

K.R. Subramanian establishes Jayveecons as an engineering consultancy in Bengaluru, focused on Vertical Shaft Kiln (VSK) technology for small-scale cement plants. Early clients are local cement manufacturers seeking cost-effective process solutions.

Bengaluru, Karnataka
Early 1990s
Expansion
From Consulting to Manufacturing

Growing demand across sectors beyond cement motivates the transition from consulting to full manufacturing. Jayveecons invests in its first fabrication facility, expanding capability to design and build material handling equipment in-house.

Manufacturing begins
2000s
Growth
Multi-Sector Capability

Product range expands to serve mining, food processing, steel, and waste management industries. The 90,000 sq.ft facility is established, housing a versatile machining and fabrication shop capable of large-scale industrial builds.

90,000 sq.ft facility
2012
Recognition
Priyadarshini Award

Jayveecons receives the Priyadarshini Award in recognition of business excellence and community contribution. Mrs. Rama Subramanian leads the company's continued growth as Managing Director.

National recognition
2015
Recognition
Women Entrepreneur Award

Awarded at the National Vendor Development Programme cum Industrial Exhibition, Kolar, Bangalore — recognising entrepreneurial leadership and contribution to Indian manufacturing. Accepted by Managing Director Mrs. Rama Subramanian alongside Health Minister Mr. K.R. RameshKumar.

NVDP Exhibition, Kolar
2016
Digital
Jayveecons Goes Online

Jayveecons launches its first website, enabling existing and new customers to engage digitally — marking the company's formal entry into the digital marketplace and signalling international ambition.

First web presence
Now
Next Chapter
VECTOMEC™ & Global Expansion

Jayveecons introduces the VECTOMEC™ equipment brand and a fully modernised digital presence, targeting expansion into Oil & Gas, Pharmaceuticals, and Agriculture Processing. The JV Group structure provides integrated design-manufacture-deliver capability through AkshayVipra El-Mec.

VECTOMEC™ · Global ambition
Mission & Philosophy

What Drives Us

"Moving Your
World Ahead"

Our commitment to this tagline is not marketing — it is engineering. Every piece of equipment we design is built to move something: raw material, processed product, or the operational efficiency of the plant it serves.

We adopted "Go Green" as a design principle long before sustainability became an industry requirement. Lean, energy-efficient equipment design reduces your operating costs and your environmental footprint — and has been our standard since the beginning.

Our quality system ensures equipment is designed and manufactured to stringent specifications — validated not just by internal testing, but by exceeding customer expectations in the field.
